description: Capability for the optional desktop widget (development-plan.md sections 26, 83). Core only: the widget reads tasks, routines and the focus session through this app's own commands, which are not permission-gated, and needs `core:event` for `widget://shown`, `widget://settings-changed` and the cross-window data-changed broadcast. Section 83's five controls are conspicuously not window permissions: move, resize, pin and hide are Rust commands that clamp and persist what they are asked for, so a webview can never place an always-on-top window off screen, size it to the desktop, or unpin itself into something the user cannot find.
